name: ascii-glyph-renderer
description: 图像转 ASCII 字符画渲染工具
interaction: Drop any image onto the canvas and watch it dissolve in real time into a living field of ASCII glyphs, where character density and brightness map to tone. Scrub a slider to shift resolution, invert the charset, or toggle between blocks, shades, and binary — then copy the raw text art straight to your clipboard.
